description.narrative: Insatsens övergripande mål är att stärka yttrandefriheten i Albanien genom att öka förtroendet för Albanska public service/RTSH. Två viktiga delmål är att förbättra RTSH:s förmåga att vara en pålitlig och trovärdig källa i det digitala medielandskapet, och att förbättra redaktionens rutiner och kvaliteten på innehållet i lokala och nationella nyhetsbevakningar. Särskilda delmål gällande jämställdhet, miljö och klimat ingår i samarbetet.

The intervention's overall goal is to strengthen freedom of expression in Albania by increasing trust in Public Service Media in Albania/RTSH. Two key outcomes are improving RTSH’s capacity to be a reliable and trustworthy public service provider in the digital media landscape and enhancing editorial routines and content quality in local and national news. Specific outputs on gender equality and environment and climate change are included in the cooperation.

The Project Overall Objective: The intervention will lead to strengthening of freedom of expression in Albania through higher trust in Public Service Media
Outcome 1: Management and staff have improved capacity to develop RTSH into a reliable and trustworthy public service provider in the digital media landscape
Outcome 2: Editorial routines and the quality of the content in the local and national news are improved

sector.narrative: Media and free flow of information

title.narrative: Decision on contribution- Cooperation Swedish Radio

description.narrative:
Despite the delayed project start until March 2024 due to changes in top management, the project successfully established cooperation with the news management teams.
- According to RTSH, the working culture has been significantly improved during 2024, with continuous workshops and training sessions taking place on topics such as Breaking News, Online Journalism, etc., aimed at raising journalistic standards and enhancing professionalism.
- Within the news organization, there is a growing willingness to engage in project activities and support the necessary changes to become a more professional news organization.
- In total 32 managers and staff from RTSH participated in the workshops, training sessions or study visits to Sweden during 2024, some of them in several activities. 90 % of participants rated the training modules as very good indicating that the content was both useful and well-organized. 80 % of participants rated the relevance and usefulness of the training for their daily work as good. In conclusion, the trainings 2024 enhanced the professional capabilities of RTSH employees. It was recommended by RTSH that these activities will continue in the future to strengthen cooperation and knowledge exchange among media professionals.
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
